info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Payments Payments Authorize-v4-spec
info.description: The Payment Authorization API enables businesses to process and authorize batch payment transactions efficiently. This endpoint allows users to submit multiple payment requests for authorization at once, streamlining the financial workflow and reducing processing time. Typical consumers of this API include payment service providers, e-commerce platforms, and financial institutions that require rapid transaction approvals. By automating the authorization process, businesses can enhance user experience and improve cash flow management.

post.description: This endpoint is used to authorize a payment for a given transaction. It ensures that the necessary funds are available and reserves them for the transaction to be finalized later.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to authorize a payment. It must include all necessary details for the payment authorization to be processed successfully.
